source.title: Reverse fixture: provider 403 is retried blindly across nested retry engines

issues.description: HTTP 403 is again treated as blindly retryable in both the outer core backoff loop and the provider retry policy, while RetryOrchestrator grants an auth refresh attempt even when no recovery handler exists. On the composed streaming path, an exhausted inner 403 preserves its status and is reclassified by the outer loop, multiplying attempts and long delays instead of surfacing a terminal forbidden/configuration error; explicit authentication recovery and bucket failover must remain the only 403 retry paths.
issues.repair_unit: remove blind status-based 403 retries while preserving explicit authentication recovery
issues.mechanism_pattern: 403 is classified as retryable by status across nested retry engines without requiring a recovery handler
issues.invariant_pattern: a forbidden response may retry only through an explicit authentication recovery or bucket failover path
